end.summary: Read and plotted ordered pairs, including (3, 2) and (2, 3).
end.parentNote: Asha practised moving right/left for x and up/down for y, and Harsh correctly explained that (3, 2) and (2, 3) are different points. Harsh first chose quadrant IV for (3, 4) because 4 is positive; this was corrected later to quadrant I, but the signs-and-quadrants method was not yet consistent. At home, practise a few points by writing the signs of x and y before naming the quadrant.
